classification: engineered illustrative model, not a Qwen measurement or duality proof
physical_model: 2D depth-averaged shallow water, HLL/hydrostatic reconstruction, SSPRK2, Manning friction; planar body with distributed linear drag and unilateral compliant pole contact
rendering: Computed local free surface and rigid-body trajectories; one prescribed upstream route-time extension drives both watercolor pigment and passive boats. Gate jet, main fall, microtexture and post-boundary sheet are illustrative optics, not 3D CFD. The 2D pole force omits vertical load and full 3D human dynamics.
main_outcome: baseline passes the side opening and crosses the downstream main section; gate/pole cross the side section
no_equivalence_claim: Same classified outlet only; not equal trajectories, forces, or general WSP/steering equivalence.
convergence: Final-config spatial convergence NOT TESTED. Previous configuration had stable outlet classes but did not meet quantitative trajectory convergence.

film.hold: whole scene is held at the recorded terminal crossing and labelled as such

visual_revision.name: transparent sidewalls
visual_revision.scope: The two side shoulders of the lateral apron are omitted from the ground/water rasterization. The ramp floor and physical boundary remain. This is a transparent-material view, not removal of the simulated boundary.
visual_revision.applies_to: Historical sidewall-only revision, before the river-continuity update.

main_outlet_visual_revision.name: one continuous curved flow atlas
main_outlet_visual_revision.scope: Reach, rounded lip and falling sheet share one watercolor advection pass. The receiving pool is anchored at the same impact. A cumulative nonnegative outlet-flow clock replaces instantaneous time scaling. This does not change the shallow-water solve or boat/actor motion.
main_outlet_visual_revision.source_registration: Aligned front/back painted water boundaries; stationary wood and rocks excluded

river_continuity_revision.scope: Prescribed causal upstream extension and continuous handoff to existing local 2D body dynamics; not full-river CFD. A inlet fields and boat trajectory recomputed; baseline/B force trajectories preserved.

rigid_pole_revision.method: A fixed camera-nullspace branch lifts a constant-length image direction to a unit 3D axis. Both hands and the rod endpoint derive from the same axis.
rigid_pole_revision.scope: Kinematic staging constraint; hidden 3D pitch is restaged. Not full 3D contact or biomechanical validation.

whole_body_revision.model: One rigid torso/pelvis transform drives both shoulders, fixed-length elbow IK, pole-oriented palm frames, weighted lower clothing, explicit foot anchors.
whole_body_revision.body_cue: Plant, drive and release, with causal 0.10 s smoothing of contact load for visual bracing only.
whole_body_revision.scope: 2D kinematic choreography; not full human dynamics or medical validation.

annotation_revision.description: Quiet scene-registered paper callouts, progressive dotted leaders and open rings.
